citeAs: Bian, Y., Chen, X., Li, Z., Zhi, T., Sang, S., Luo, L., & Xu, Q. (2025). Video-As-Prompt: Unified Semantic Control for Video Generation. arXiv preprint arXiv:2510.20888.
creator: Yuxuan Bian, Xin Chen, Zenan Li, Tiancheng Zhi, Shen Sang, Linjie Luo, Qiang Xu (ByteDance, The Chinese University of Hong Kong)
description: A large-scale dataset for semantic-controlled video generation containing over 100K paired videos across 100 semantic conditions.
name: VAP-Data
publisher: ByteDance, The Chinese University of Hong Kong
rai:dataBiases: The dataset is synthetic and derived from other generative models, which may inherit the specific stylistic biases, artifacts, and conceptual limitations of the source templates (e.g., poor at generating hands).
rai:dataCollection: Collected 2K high-quality reference images from the Internet, then used Image-to-Video visual-effects templates from commercial models (VIDU and Kling) and community LoRAs to create paired videos.
rai:dataLimitations: The semantic conditions are relatively limited, synthetic, and derived from other generative models, inheriting their artifacts and conceptual limitations.
rai:dataSocialImpact: Potential misuses include identity impersonation, deepfake content, targeted harassment, deceptive political messaging, and generation of sexualized or violent media. Mitigated by a research-only release and default content filters.
